title: 3d assets for building a race track
author: ANMGP_Studio
selftext:
I am using Grok, MeshyAi and Claude for building a racetrack in Godot. The visual result is far lower from what I want, basically I am feeling that I am back in to 2005.

I would love to have some suggestions about tools or certain automations to use for better results.

comments.author: SidAkrita
comments.body: What kind of assets are you talking about? Scenery, roads, the sides of the track, rubble, asphalt, maybe just materials?

replies.author: ANMGP_Studio
replies.body: Where the project fails mostly is the visual quality of buildings and the surroundings of the race track,  the asphalt, grass or gravel look good, also I managed to have good car models.

replies.author: SidAkrita
replies.body: For buildings you could use ones you find on internet, and build upon them. IMO 3d asset generation is still really difficult with Ai, you can get some impressive results but getting above the "slop barrier" is hard, especially if you are trying to get a photorealstic look.

replies.author: ANMGP_Studio
replies.body: I did manage to get good results but for a stand alone object. If you put all of them together.....performance issues....

replies.author: SidAkrita
replies.body: Do you know how many vertices you have on your mesh? Maybe it's just a topology issue.

replies.author: ANMGP_Studio
replies.body: The buildings that catch the eye have approx 1.4 milion the ones that look bad something like half of them

replies.author: SidAkrita
replies.body: You have your answer then, 1.4 million vertices for a building is just HUGE. You can aim towards 10k vertices for really detailed buildings, but in a racing game you could go lower. You might have a lot of vertices because of details directly made in the mesh, instead use normal maps to get the effects you want. A lot of parts of your buildings should be simple quads I think.

replies.author: ANMGP_Studio
replies.body:
Yes, I also think that I have to work with the lighting and the camera angles.
I will work on it!
I really appreciate your help!

replies.author: SidAkrita
replies.body: No worries ! I'm working on a 2D top down racing game myself, I already tried a few times to work on 3D racing games, it's haaard ! Good luck !

comments.author: CmdrCallandra
comments.body:
For these kinds of problems I build my own app, so as long as you have 16 GB vram you can do local asset generation with it, even characters, animation, pixel art. I already used it to generate assets to build my city diorama....

https://github.com/SifuInTheShell/Effigy

replies.author: ANMGP_Studio
replies.body: Thank you! I will check it!
